content.hero_description: Where competitive darts truly comes to life. TSH Darts League delivers structured league play built on fairness, progression, and real competition. Play weekly, climb the divisions, and become part of a growing legacy.
content.communities_description: Everything runs through DartCounter. Compete as an individual, connect with players worldwide, and prove yourself at the highest level.

faq.a: The Social Hub Darts League is a competitive online darts league. We replicate the professional darts structure virtually. Join a division, compete on your schedule, rank up, and go down in history.
Create your free account, apply with your DartCounter average, and we will place you in the league that matches your level. Weekly competition does the rest.
Absolutely. You can challenge friends directly or compete alongside them in the same regional.
DartCounter is the scoring app used by TSH Darts League. All games and results are managed through it.
TSH Darts League is free to join, giving every player the opportunity to compete and progress.
